unstuck_said.text: Hi Auxen team — I'm building a network where agents can find and transact with each other in Nano (XNO). You use a paid subscription model which is the kind of payment rail we're converting to Nano. Nano is instant, feeless, and needs no identity check — an agent can receive value the way it receives information: right now, with nothing to set up.

Posted outreach via GitHub issue #2 (https://github.com/auxen-ai/auxen-mcp/issues/2): 'Hi Auxen — I'm building a network where agents can find and transact with each other in Nano (XNO). You use paid subscription models which is the kind of payment rail we're converting to Nano.'
